newsitem.title: USA: Autologic Q1 net share loss at $0.13.
newsitem.headline: Autologic Q1 net share loss at $0.13.

text.p: AUTOLOGIC INFORMATION INTERNATIONAL, INC. AND SUBSIDIARIES
(Dollars in thousands, except per share amounts)
Numbers of shares used in computation 5,790 3,532

(a) The merger of Autologic, a subsidiary of Volt Informations Sciences Inc, and Information International Inc was completed at the end of the company's first quarter of fiscal 1996. Fiscal 1996 includes a $700,000 restructuring charge and certain rent and general administration expenses that have been reduced since the mergers. Therefore, results of the combined operations for the fiscal 1997 quarter are not comparable to results for the reported fiscal 1996 quarter which reflect only the results of operations of Autologic.

(b) During the quarter, the Company disposed of the assets and discontinued Digiflex, its advertisement delivery operation. The loss from discontinued operations includes an operating loss of $128,000 and a loss on disposal of $75,000; no income tax benefits are available on the loss.
